question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Amazon)

calls.reasoning: Amazon guided Q3 2026 net sales $197.0-202.0B (midpoint 199.5, ~80bp FX headwind assumed). In each of the last 6 quarters actual revenue beat the top of guidance; actual minus midpoint ran about +2.5 to +6.2B (mean ~+4.3B). That implies ~203.8B. Published consensus is 202.1-205.65B. Upside: AWS accelerating (37% in Q2). Downside: Prime Day moved into Q2, and FX changes since July are unknown. No human market on this was found (Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi searched; Kalshi only lists headcount markets). Escape beyond 198B or 209B would need a historic miss or beat, so it is not priced.

- Q2 2026 actual $200.6B (+20% YoY), FX +$0.1B. Segments: North America $116.2B (+16%), International $42.2B (+15%), AWS $42.2B (+37%, fastest in 18 quarters).
- Q2 2026 guidance was $194-199B; actual $200.6B (+1.6B over top). Prime Day 2026 moved to June 23-26 (in Q2); in 2025 it was in July (Q3). That makes the Q3 2026 YoY comp harder and explains the guided growth drop.
- Past actual vs guidance range (from memory, approximate): Q1'25 guide 151-155.5, actual 155.7; Q2'25 159-164, actual 167.7; Q3'25 174-179.5, actual 180.2; Q4'25 206-213, actual 213.4; Q1'26 actual 181.5 (guide ~173.5-178.5, unverified); Q2'26 194-199, actual 200.6. Actual minus midpoint: about +2.5 to +6.2B; the top of guidance was beaten every time in this sample.
- Consensus revenue (Oct 2026): tradingpedia (Oct 5) $205.65B; other aggregators $202.14B and $204.6B averages. EPS consensus ~$1.96-2.02.
- Tradingpedia: Amazon has beaten consensus benchmarks five consecutive quarters. Yahoo: EPS beat only 2 of the last 4 quarters.
- AWS demand supported by Anthropic (Q3 revenue $16.8B, per Reuters/AOL Oct 16); macro AI-financing jitters (Invezz Oct 17).
- Status quo: an Amazon print near or just above the top of guidance.
- Resolution: total net sales in the Q3 2026 earnings release (8-K), expected Oct 29 2026; initial figure only.
- Event window: Q3 2026 (Jul 1 - Sep 30) is fully elapsed; the release is ~12 days away as of Oct 17 2026.
- Not found: FX moves since late July 2026 (USD vs EUR/GBP/JPY); no prediction market on Amazon revenue (Kalshi has headcount markets only).
